newsitem.title: CANADA: CN and CP up on market momentum.
newsitem.headline: CN and CP up on market momentum.

text.p: Shares of Canadian National Railway were trading at a new 12-month high of C$55.30 on the Toronto Stock Exchange on late Friday afternoon, buoyed by market momentum.

Shares of Canadian National were 1.05 higher than Thursday's close. Shares of Canada's other national railway concern, Canadian Pacific Ltd, were also trading at a 12-month high of 37.10, up 40 cents from Thursday.
Both railway stocks were being carried along by the strong momentum of the TSE during the week, said Ted Larkin, an analyst at Bunting Warburg Inc.
"There is absolutely nothing new. It's just positive sentiment on both stories," Larkin said.
